batch.topic: A visitor runs into an old friend by chance; encounter is not a collision and no meeting was arranged.
A speaker weighs up two options and postpones a decision; evaluation is not a physical measurement.
A person is tied up with an earlier commitment and can respond later; unavailable is distinct from refusing and from physical restraint.
A team wraps up a discussion without agreeing to implement a proposal; ending discussion is not packaging or final authorization.
